text:
Maya: quick heads-up — scheduling rolling NIC microcode + GPU driver minor bump in eu-west3 tonight 22:00-02:00 UTC. We'll do cohorted reboots of gpu-pool-b / gpu-pool-c, ~10% capacity per wave. Expected per-wave impact: ~12 nodes -> ~8% capacity loss. Backfill plan in place.

Liam: noted. which tenants hit first? any high-priority customers?

Maya: priority order: internal + dev accounts first, then low-throughput prod, then high-throughput prod canaries. We'll avoid reserved/dedicated pools. Tenant examples: saturn, aurora (dev), beta-corp (low-prod). Full list & timeline in runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/egress-microcode-euw3

Jordan: SRE oncall @oncall — can you cover 21:45-02:30? I'd like extra eyes during wave 3 -> 4.

Jordan: also planning gradual traffic shift to us-west1 for the most latency-sensitive inference jobs (will coordinate routing).

Priya: finance flag — if we cross 5000 GPU-minutes of backfill we need to approve cost center switchover. Can you estimate expected usage?

Maya: estimate is ~3.5k GPU-minutes if everything goes to plan. If we hit unexpected rollbacks / retries could approach 6k. We'll throttle preemptible bursts to try to stay <=4k.

Kyle: ops note — cordon/evac sequence we'll run per-node: 
```
kubectl cordon node-<id>
kubectl drain node-<id> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=10m
```

Maya: canary starts 22:00 UTC (2 nodes). health checks to watch: p95 latency, 5xx error-rate, KV cache warmup time, token throughput. If any metric degrades >20% we pause.

engbot: Deploy bot: Scheduled maintenance created: eu-west3 cohort-reboots starting 2026-03-22T22:00Z — ticket #INC-3812

Liam: customer comms plan: prod customers get 48h email, staging tenants get banner and a short note in console. Priya can you sign off on the billing/cost note?

Priya: signed. I'll draft the billing notice and cost estimate (will attach spreadsheet).

Jordan: rollback trigger: sustained netflap or >10% prod error-rate for 10m. Rollback steps: stop reboots, rewarm caches in place, escalate to netinfra & storage. Runbook has details.

Maya: final checklist for 21:30 warroom: 
- oncall present (Jordan)
- runbook open and pinned
- canary metrics dashboards pinned
- comms sent out
- cost ops notified (Priya)

Maya: pinging @Kyle to post short update to #incidents at each wave start with template: pool, nodes, impact, ETA.

Kyle: will post at wave start and update after each cohort. :thumbsup:

Maya: thanks — I'll post final confirmation at 21:40.
